jobs.title: bm-b 工具链取证：为什么同一条 python 卡在 bm-b 上零产物且 rc=0
jobs.cmd: cmd /c "(echo NODE=%COMPUTERNAME% & echo DATE=%DATE% %TIME% & echo --- & python -V & where python & where py & git -C . rev-parse HEAD & git -C . status --porcelain -uno & dir /b Tools\fleet\line_triage.py & python Tools\fleet\line_triage.py --line fluxverse --node bm-b & echo TRIAGE-RC=%ERRORLEVEL% & dir /b cph4\fleet\queue-receipts\triage-fluxverse-bm-b-20261110.md & echo ALL-DONE) > cph4\fleet\queue-receipts\probe-bm-b-20261110.txt 2>&1"

jobs.title: [probe] bm-b 到 bm-a/bm-c 的 WinRM 可达性
jobs.cmd:
python -c "import subprocess,os,datetime;os.makedirs('cph4/fleet/reports',exist_ok=True);ps='$a=Test-NetConnection 100.110.185.62 -Port 5985 -InformationLevel Quiet;$b=Test-NetConnection 100.123.74.104 -Port 5985 -InformationLevel Quiet;"bm-a="+$a+" bm-c="+$b';r=subprocess.run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',ps],capture_output=True,text=True);open('cph4/fleet/reports/bmb-winrm.md','w',encoding='utf-8').write('# bm-b -> 邻居 WinRM 探测

- out: '+(r.stdout or '').strip()+'
- err: '+(r.stderr or '')[:300]+'
- rc: '+str(r.returncode)+'
')"

jobs.title: [self-heal] bm-b 分叉收口（reset 到 origin/main，先留备份分支）
jobs.cmd: git -C . fetch origin --prune && git -C . branch -f backup/bm-b-20261110 HEAD 2>nul & git -C . reset --hard origin/main && git -C . log -1 --oneline > cph4/fleet/reports/node-sync-bm-b-20261110.md
